title: Prefix Membership After a Marker Run
statement: Let $\ell$ be a function from bit strings to natural numbers, let $V$ be a language of bit strings, let $y,p$ be bit strings, and let $k$ be a natural number. The encoding of $y$ paired with a string of $k$ ones followed by $0p$ belongs to the prefix language defined by $\ell$ and $V$ if and only if there exists a bit string $s$ such that $\lvert ps\rvert=\ell(y)$ and $\langle y,ps\rangle\in V$.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a function from bit strings to natural numbers
$V$ is a language of bit strings
